title: Cardamom honey cake
subtitle: a spiced loaf cake with a close crumb, honey throughout and a warm cardamom note
excerpt: Honey replaces most of the sugar in this loaf cake, which gives it a characteristic chewiness and a deeper, floral sweetness than caster sugar alone. Ground cardamom is the dominant spice. The cake keeps exceptionally well: the honey retains moisture for up to five days and the flavour develops as it sits.
sourceNotes: Honey and cardamom cake, informed by Nordic and Middle Eastern baking traditions. Method from contemporary British home-baking practice.

glossaryTerms.definition: Honey acts as both a sweetener and a humectant, drawing moisture from the air and keeping baked goods moist longer than sugar alone. It also contributes flavour and can make a cake slightly denser than one made with the same weight of caster sugar.

recipe.freezeNotes: Wrap the cooled cake tightly in cling film and freeze for up to 2 months. Defrost at room temperature.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Keeps in an airtight tin for up to 5 days. The flavour improves on day 2 and 3.

content.text: and ground cardamom works best with a mild-flavoured honey (acacia or clover) rather than a strong variety like manuka or buckwheat, which would compete with the spice. Use the freshest ground cardamom you have; pre-ground cardamom loses its top notes quickly.
Heat the oven to 160°C fan. Grease a 900 g loaf tin and line with baking parchment.
Beat the butter, honey, and light brown sugar together in a large bowl until pale and slightly fluffy, about 3 minutes with a hand mixer.
Add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each. Add a spoonful of flour if the mixture looks like it is about to curdle.
Fold in the sifted flour and ground cardamom, then stir in the milk until just combined.

Pour into the prepared tin and bake for 50 to 55 minutes until a skewer inserted in the centre comes out clean and the cake is deep golden on top. Cover loosely with foil if it browns too quickly in the last 15 minutes. Cool in the tin for 20 minutes before turning out.

attrs.problem: Cake very dark on top but not cooked through
attrs.avoid: Avoid too high a temperature; honey burns faster than sugar.
attrs.fix: Cover with foil after 30 minutes and lower the oven temperature by 10°C for the remainder of the bake.

attrs.avoid: Avoid using pre-ground cardamom that has been open for more than a few months.
attrs.fix: Grind whole green cardamom pods yourself; crack the pods, remove the seeds, and grind them in a spice grinder. The flavour is significantly more intense.
